result.rule: When the description names alternative actions that can each signal or cause the same subsequent step: model each stated alternative as a distinct activity or event and preserve its path to the shared step, rather than omitting an alternative or substituting a different action

When the description presents successive activities without stating a choice, condition, or decision between them: model the activities in sequence and do not insert an exclusive gateway between them
